In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All S are B.

II. Some B are C.

**Conclusions:**

I. All S are C.

II. No C is B.

III. All B are S.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f96611528463ce826e619fea15220e4f99da13bed2236c9b29ff9f425a97ba20.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All S are C →** Does not f**ollow (As all S are B and some B are C. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

II. No C is B → Does not follow (As some B are C. So, as no negative or cross relation between C and B is given therefore it is definitely false)

III. All B are S → Does not follow (As all S are B. So, it is possible but not definitely true)

∴ Here, None of the conclusions I, II and III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Neither conclusion follows**".

Which of the following interchange of numbers and mathematical signs would make the given equation correct?

72 ÷ 6 − 20 + 30 × 5 = 70

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebadc30a979bf1a7e953d20901c3e7953c575296c0e0bb4af8a458ec3a64ab2c.png] 

Given statement : **72 ÷ 6 − 20 + 30 × 5 = 70**

According to the question, after interchanging the given signs and numbers :

So,

__
 
• Option - (1) : 5 and 20, − and ×

Given statement : 72 ÷ 6 − 20 + 30 × 5 = 70

after interchanging the given signs and numbers :

**72 ÷ 6**__ × 5 + 30 - 20 = 70

__**12 × 5**__ + 30 - 20 = 70

__**60**____** + 30**__ - 20 = 70

__**90 - 20**__ = 70

**70 = 70 (LHS = RHS)**

__
 
• Option - (2) : 20 and 30, × and ÷

 

Given statement : 72 ÷ 6 − 20 + 30 × 5 = 70

after interchanging the given signs and numbers :

72 × 6 − 30 + **20 ÷ 5**__ = 70

__**72 × 6**__ − 30 + 4 = 70

__**432 + 4**__ - 30 = 70

__**436 - 30**__ = 70

**406 ≠ 70 (LHS ≠ RHS)**

__
 
• Option - (3) : 5 and 70, + and −

 

Given statement : 72 ÷ 6 − 20 + 30 × 5 = 70

after interchanging the given signs and numbers :

**72 ÷ 6**__ + 20 - 30 × 70 = 5

12 + 20 - __**30 × 70**__ = 5

__**12 + 20**__ - 2100 = 5

__**32 - 2100**__ = 5

- 2068 ≠ 5 (LHS ≠ RHS)

__
 
• Option - (4) : 6 and 20, + and ÷

 

Given statement : 72 ÷ 6 − 20 + 30 × 5 = 70

after interchanging the given signs and numbers :

72 + 20 − **6 ÷ 30**__ × 5 = 70

72 + 20 − __**0.2 × 5**__ = 70

__**72 + 20**__ - 1 = 70

__**92 - 1**__ = 70

91 ≠ 70 (LHS ≠ RHS)

Hence, "Option - (1)" is the correct answer.
